desc.en: Wild, hardy sheep that live in the desert. Their well built meat from running about in the wild is quite delicious. Over hunting caused a large drop in numbers before, so hunters have now set quotas for hunting them.
desc.ja: 砂漠でたくましく生きる、野生のヒツジ。大地を駆けまわり引き締まった肉はとても美味しい。乱獲で数が激減しないよう、猟師たちの間で狩猟数が調整れている
